description: VN 'rất' premodifies verbs (rất muốn/thích), but English 'very' cannot modify a finite verb; the intensifier must be 'really'. Replaces 'very' with 'really' on a closed pronoun + very + verb-whitelist (want/love/need/enjoy/hope/miss + -s forms), EXCLUDING like/likes which stay owned by en-vietlish-very-like.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. Fires only on a pronoun immediately adjacent to 'very' followed by a closed verb whitelist. Adjective uses ('is very tired', 'very good'), adverbs ('very quickly'), the 'very much want' pattern (intervening 'much' breaks adjacency), and 'very like/likes' (owned by en-vietlish-very-like) all abstain — the negatives stress each of these FP surfaces.

positive.notes: rất muốn -> 'really want'; 'very' cannot modify the finite verb 'want'.
Third-person -s verb form ('loves') is on the whitelist; subject preserved.
'miss' on the whitelist; rất nhớ -> 'really miss'.

negative.notes: 'very' correctly modifies the adjective 'good' — no verb match.
The intervening 'much' breaks pronoun + very + verb adjacency — abstain.
'like' is EXCLUDED from this rule's whitelist; en-vietlish-very-like owns it. This rule must not fire (verified via mustNotFire); the engine still corrects via the other rule.
Adverb modification ('very quickly') with no subject pronoun — no match.
'is' between subject and 'very' breaks adjacency; 'very tired' is a correct adjective phrase.
